title: Prometheus scrape coordinator + OTel export harmonization for multi-tenant inference KPIs
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Goal: build a resilient coordinator layer that harmonizes Prometheus scrapes and OpenTelemetry metric exports for Redwood inference KPIs across hosted and dedicated deployments. Deliverables: (1) a canonical metric name + label set for custom inference KPIs, (2) an OTel Collector pipeline that normalizes and forwards metrics to Cortex/Prometheus remote_write, (3) a scrape-coordinator service to manage scrape targets and stable relabeling for multi-tenant ingestion, and (4) migration playbook and dashboards to validate parity and SLOs.
proposal: 1) Define canonical metric schema: inference_requests_total, inference_errors_total, inference_latency_seconds_bucket (histogram), kv_cache_hit_ratio, model_inflight_requests, model_batch_size. Labels: model_id, model_version, deployment_env, region, org_hash (sha256 short), route, quantization_profile. 2) OTel Collector pipeline: prometheus receiver -> transform processor (rename/label normalization/drop PII) -> batch -> prometheusremotewrite exporter to Cortex. 3) Scrape coordinator: single control plane service that generates scrape configs with relabel_configs to ensure stable label cardinality and prevents label explosion. 4) Dual-write mode for eight weeks: current prometheus scrapers + new OTel path; run data parity checks and histogram diffing daily. 5) Add deterministic sampling for traces attached to tail latency buckets (store 1 trace per model per minute) via trace-hook integration to link metrics <-> traces.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical metric schema doc published in Confluence and linked from README
OTel Collector config validated in staging and accepts both Prometheus scraped targets and direct OTel exports
Scrape coordinator deployed in staging and reduces duplicate label cardinality by >= 90% on test workload
Daily parity checks show <1% drift for 95th/99th latency buckets across dual-write path for 48h test
Dashboards (latency, error-rate, tail traces) updated and reviewed by SRE and PM
Migration playbook with rollback steps and canary verification documented
implementation_plan: Phase A (spike, 1 week): prototype OTel Collector transforms for label normalization and histogram handling. Phase B (2 weeks): implement scrape-coordinator service (k8s controller) that generates stable relabel rules and manages target lifecycle for multi-tenant envs. Phase C (1 week): integrate deterministic trace sampling hook from serving runtime and wire to tracing-storage. Phase D (1 week): deploy dual-write to staging, run parity tests, tune histogram buckets. Phase E (1 week): staged rollout to prod (canary on small customer pool) with automated parity checks and alerting. Assignments: Luca leads collector/relabel work, Priya implements scrape-coordinator, Aisha implements trace hooks, SRE owns parity job and dashboards.
rollout_plan:
- Deploy OTel Collector config with transform processor behind feature flag.
- Enable dual-write in a small subset of frontends (10% traffic) for 72h.
- Run automated parity suite: time-series diff, histogram KL divergence, label cardinality report.
- Expand canary to 50% then 100% if parity <1% for key KPIs.
- Flip off old collector scrapers after 14 days of stable parity and update runbook.
- Post-mortem and metrics retention review after 30 days.
testing_plan: Unit tests for relabel rules and transform processor. Integration tests: local OTel Collector + mini Cortex to verify remote_write. Synthetic load harness to generate multi-tenant workloads with high-cardinality route labels and verify cardinality reduction. Parity job: compare prom_remote_write path vs legacy ingestion for counts, rates, and histograms; export daily report to #observability channel. E2E smoke: dashboards refresh within 60s for new metrics, alert firing verified in staging.
comments: 2025-02-12 Sofia Chen: Triage notes — multiple customers reported noisy per-route metrics leading to OOMs in Cortex; observed label explosion from per-request route_id. This ticket scopes a migration to normalized labels and an OTel path.

2025-02-14 Luca Marino: Spike results — transform processor can normalize metric names and drop raw route_id, but we found a problem: histogram bucket boundaries were being altered by an upstream SDK for older clients. Need compatibility layer to remap buckets to canonical boundaries.

2025-02-15 Priya Nair: Scrape coordinator design doc uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Scrape+Coordinator. It describes k8s-based target discovery and relabel generation with a max-cardinality policy per-org.

2025-02-17 Aisha Patel: Trace hook prototype done. We can attach span attributes (model_id, model_version, batch_size) and sample 1 trace per minute per model using deterministic hashing on request_id. Will open PR for runtime changes.

2025-02-18 Luca Marino: Found memory leak in collectd plugin when running with 5k targets in staging. Mitigation: throttle scrape concurrency and backpressure in collector; tracked separately in ENG-41301.

2025-02-19 Sofia Chen: PM review — prioritize dual-write parity checks and dashboard updates before broad rollout. Link to dashboard mockups: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inf-kpis/metric-consolidation
